taskName: Triage tickets in an internal web tool (reload-and-confirm prompt)
prompt: The support queue is open in the browser. Assign all of Acme Ltd's open tickets to Dana, and set the ticket about the login outage to urgent priority. Save each row you change. When you are done, reload the page and confirm that each changed row still shows the new values after the reload; if a row reverted, fix it and save again.
